title: Dispatching to the workshop
intro: Dispatch records garments leaving the showroom for the workshop. Only orders already processed by a cashier appear in this queue.

steps.title: Dispatch the order
steps.body: Select Dispatch Orders in the sidebar (1). The New orders tab lists all orders available for dispatch. Select Dispatch against the order (2).

steps.title: Confirming the dispatch
steps.body: The order is removed from the New orders tab and is recorded as in transit to the workshop. A dispatch made in error can be reversed using Undo on the notification, for approximately one minute and only until the workshop records receipt.
